item.title: PsychoPy vs jsPsych vs lab.js in 2026: Which Open-Source Platform Should Run Your Behavioral Experiment?
item.description: Every behavioral lab hits the same wall. The stimulus presentation software that defined the field — E-Prime, Presentation, SuperLab — is licensed per seat, per machine, and per year, and the licence rarely covers running participants online. Meanwhile half the subjects you need are at home with a laptop, not in your lab with a calibrated monitor.
